problem_statement: Slicing an Array with full slices along every dimension should just map the keys ``` ds = xr.open_zarr( "gs://weatherbench2/datasets/era5/1959-2023_01_10-wb13-6h-1440x721.zarr", #consolidated=True ) ds = ds[variables].sel(time=slice("2020-01-01", "2022-12-31")) ``` The dataset has one point per chunk along the time axis, so every slice is trivial this creates a lot of tasks that look like this: ``` ('getitem-cbd92e9090b2dd038943d6de9184aefe', 1, 0, 0): (, ('open_dataset-sea_surface_temperature-c20638560e986ac27140dafa0e57ac52', 89121, 0, 0), (slice(None, None, None), slice(None, None, None), slice(None, None, None))), ``` We should optimise this away to something like: ``` ('getitem-cbd92e9090b2dd038943d6de9184aefe', 1, 0, 0): ('open_dataset-sea_surface_temperature-c20638560e986ac27140dafa0e57ac52', 89121, 0, 0), ```
